channel.title: Wire — DevOps
channel.description: DevOps from thirty sources, one digest a day.

item.title: Google Cloud Launches AI-powered Agents to Simplify Database Lifecycle Management
item.description: Google Cloud has introduced AI-powered Database Operations Agents, featuring an Onboarding Agent that streamlines database setup and an Observability Agent that helps automate troubleshooting, performance optimization, and tuning. (1 source: infoq)

item.title: Kubernetes v1.37: Garhwal
item.description: Editors: Arsh Sharma, Christopher Tineo, Kirti Goyal, Sophia Ugochukwu, Swathi Rao, Troy Connor Similar to previous releases, the release of Kubernetes v1.37 introduces new Stable, Beta, and Alpha features. (1 source: kubernetesblog)

item.title: Stream HCP Vault Dedicated audit logs to Microsoft Sentinel
item.description: HCP Vault Dedicated has no native Microsoft Sentinel connector. Deploy a Terraform-managed pipeline that streams audit logs into Azure Log Analytics and Microsoft Sentinel. (1 source: hashicorp)

item.title: Streamline identity lifecycle management on HCP with SCIM provisioning
item.description: New HCP SCIM provisioning automates user and group lifecycle management from your identity provider to reduce admin overhead and improve secure, consistent access. (1 source: hashicorp)

item.title: GitHub confirms Actions outage caused by database issue
item.description: If your GitHub Actions jobs are stuck in "Queued" or waiting for a runner, GitHub has now confirmed there is an incident. GitHub says they identified an issue with a database primary and are failing over to a replica. (1 source: rprogramming)
